dexEntries.First Caught: Erbacub roams the forest gathering leaves and twigs, often seen tying them together with vines. It seems eager to prove itself, though its paws still tremble in battle.
Bearosion patrols forests like a ranger. Its safari hat never falls off, even during battle. It exudes leadership and calm strength.
Hileaph towers over the forest, wielding a fallen tree. Its wide-brim safari hat casts a long shadow, under which others gather for safety.
Sparcoon has a tail that glows brighter with its excitement, often setting the area around it aflame in its playful antics.
Blazuki glides across tall heights and long distances, leaving streaks of embers in the air. Its fiery mohawk flares up even further when it flies, warning others of its incoming presence.
Axolitl is often seen with its head dipped low. A mysterious crystal grows where its gills should be, making it difficult to lift its head above water. The crystal pulses faintly when it feels safe.
Axolote loses it's once gentle movements and now have an alien quality to them. It now also appears to mutter to itself in an unknown language.

Axolarg towers above its foes, with a hulking physique sculpted by its crystalline armor. The only part of its body not encased in crystals is its head, and a floating crystal hovers above it, pulsing with mysterious energy.

Dribsom lurks in alleys and caves, its wings flapping silently as it watches from the shadows. Despite its small size, it's known for stealing food and vanishing into the night sky with a hiss-like screech. They also pick on small prey in the nighttime.
A sagey fish that got algae grown on it from sleeping on the bottom of the river.
A triangle eel that hits itself with its end to make sound.
Roadrunner that has feet that ignite flames. Tail is connected to bomb/dynamite and the tail acts as a fuse. It uses it to launch forward.
A coyote firelighter creature that eats Pyroads in order to cause an explosion inside of itself. It does this as its source of energy.
Chipmunk that causes mirages to duplicate itself.
A small little bonzai plant with a small little sapling coming out of the top.
A humanoid flower pot creature. Its top releases a cherry tree. It holds a scythe, and can shoot energy slashes using the scythe.
A huge hulking flower pot, more or less humanoid, with a beanstalk coming out the top. It holds two scythes, in the shape of scissors.

base.name: Bewag
base.visualDescription: A red fleshy ghost, giving a slight transparent (but not actually) effect. The limbs are stretched beyond human-like, and the eyes are hollowed out.

base.name: Shiver Shocks
base.visualDescription: Looks extremely similar to Nonignite, however is notable a robot version. Rather than being a lava lamp, it is a plasma lamp. The suckers on it's tentacles are now defibrillators. Instead of the UPRO logo (on the current model), it has a yellow cross. Shiver Shocks is used for heart support, which is why it is found in hospitals and sometimes buildings, homes, and schools.

base.name: Frankfortress
base.visualDescription: A fortress made of hotdog/sausages. I'm sure this isn't that hard to conceptualize.

dexEntries.First Caught: A huge clay golem. Everytime it gets hit, it turns more golden.
Water Panther representation. It appears to be an oversized lynx, with slight dragon characteristics. The top of its body has dorsal plates.

Thunderbird representation. It appears to be a very colorful bird. It has a serious brow, and radiates lightning off itself. It has pterodactyl wings, only with feathers. Its head and neck are able to twist around fully, like a more extreme owl.

base.name: Vigilith
base.visualDescription: Blindfold (for see no evil), similar design to Statue of Liberty (Green-Orange Designs, Dress, Crown), and not as beanish.

base.name: Signilith
base.visualDescription: Gag-esque feature (for say no evil), similar design to Lincoln Memorial, openable chest cavity with Huge Bell inside (Liberty Bell), Arms and Legs like Insane Asylum. (It also is in a curled up pose)

base.name: Agilith
base.visualDescription: Destroyed/Cracked Ear Holes (for hear no evil), similar design to Freedom (White, Dress, Crown), and can should imply being able to compress and extend.

dexEntries.First Caught: Cobra male butler. Unrelated to Maidusa.
Cobra female maid. Unrelated to Serventine.
A small dragon with thorns for horns. Its neck is unusually long, and mushrooms appear from the neck to the head. Its made of rotting plants, and releases a horrid smell because of that.

A large dragon that has absorbed a landfill of plants. It struggles to move around, because of its bodily components, and the mushrooms and thorns protruding from its body all over. It causes decay all around it, to be able to add more to its body. However, it spends most of its time in murky waters, so that it dampens itself. Some have even dubbed it a monster of the bodies of water it goes into.
A rhino made out of mac and cheese. Humps are melted cheese, while the rest of its body is pasta.
